# Model complexity (generated by scripts/measure_complexity.py)

GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU; torch 2.13.0+cu130. FLOPs = 2 x MACs for one 224x224 image, main KL head only. Latency = median ms per image (batch time / batch size). Latency is specific to this hardware.

| Model | Params, inference (M) | Checkpoint (MB) | GFLOPs | ms/img b=1 fp32 | ms/img b=1 fp16 | ms/img b=32 fp32 | ms/img b=32 fp16 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DenseNet121 (plain CORAL) | 8.0 | 33 | 5.67 | 12.3 | 13.7 | 2.51 | 1.35 |
| DenseNet121 + OARSI aux heads | 8.0 | 33 | 5.67 | 9.2 | 10.4 | 2.53 | 1.35 |
| ConvNeXt-Tiny | 28.6 | 115 | 8.91 | 3.5 | 4.6 | 2.89 | 1.38 |
| EfficientNet-B4 | 19.4 | 78 | 3.01 | 9.4 | 11.8 | 3.08 | 1.47 |
| Swin-T | 28.3 | 114 | 8.98 | 8.1 | 9.8 | 3.85 | 1.93 |

Note: batch-1 latencies are noisy (GPU clock/launch overhead; the two DenseNet rows have identical architecture yet differ by ~3 ms), so use the batch-32 columns for comparisons. Parameters and GFLOPs are exact.

Reference (reported by Azad & Anik, IEEE Access 2025, their own hardware, not re-measured here): stacked ensemble 77.3 M parameters, 335 MB, 13.14 GFLOPs (their FLOP definition not stated).
